sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，热身 v2-1：低冲击开合踏步+大绕环 60 秒）

name.zh: 低冲击开合踏步+大绕环

purpose.zh: 不跳的全身热身：脚左右踏开、双臂上举和大绕环，把心率和肩膀一起热起来
purpose.en: A no-jump full-body warm-up: step out side to side while the arms reach overhead and then circle, warming up your heart rate and shoulders.

text.zh: 脚轮流往旁边踏开再收回，双臂伸直举过头
text.en: Step out and in, straight arms overhead

text.zh: 一只脚踏出时另一只脚始终踩在地上，不跳。
text.en: One foot always stays on the floor as the other steps out; no jumping.

text.zh: 后半分钟手臂换成大绕环：手臂伸直，掌心朝外，绕得越大越好。
text.en: For the second half, straight arms draw big circles, palms facing out.

text.zh: 支撑腿膝盖微弯，身体站高，别弓背。
text.en: Soft knee on the standing leg, stand tall, no hunching.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

cautions.zh: 肩膀有疼痛就把绕环改小
cautions.en: If your shoulder hurts, make the circles smaller.

flare2.item: 热身 v2-1：低冲击开合踏步+大绕环 60 秒
flare2.camera: 正前略偏右（看得到踏步宽度和手臂绕环）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：60 秒（前 30 秒上举，后 30 秒大绕环），1 组
flare2.note: Animation r2: one 16 s loop = 8 s step jack with arms overhead + 8 s step jack with backward arm circles (palms out); about 1 step per second, never airborne. Text/voice carry the 30 s switch.

set.zh: 一只脚始终踩在地上，不用跳
set.en: One foot always on the floor, no jumping

set.zh: 手臂伸直，往头顶上方够
支撑腿膝盖微弯，身体站高
后半段手臂改成大绕环，掌心朝外
set.en: Second half: big arm circles, palms facing out

set.zh: 绕环画大一点，手肘别弯
set.en: Make the circles big, elbows straight

set.zh: 肩膀放松往下，别耸到耳朵
set.en: Shoulders down, away from your ears
